# foghorn

> A Claude Code plugin that drafts technical release notes for a tag range in the voice of esbuild's releases. A TypeScript checker fails notes that skip the facts a reader needs. The default voice is esbuild-plus. The checker runs without Claude on Node 22.18 or later.

foghorn has three skills: draft, check and voice. A person reviews every draft. foghorn never publishes.

## Docs

- [Home](https://gagoar.github.io/foghorn/): what it is, install, how it differs from --generate-notes
- [Showcase](https://gagoar.github.io/foghorn/showcase.html): a real run for typescript-patterns-enforcer v0.6.0
- [Voice](https://gagoar.github.io/foghorn/voice.html): the ten patterns, the three presets, calibration numbers
- [Guide](https://gagoar.github.io/foghorn/guide.html): commands, checks, config, dependencies, read-only guarantees, privacy, FAQ
